items.title: Forelegs fused into one tan column (stage 1 unlock)
items.evidence: 2_closeups front limb: two separate tan columns from the ruff down; 1_beauty az000: visible gap between the legs from the chest floor. Hind legs also read as two columns in back34.

items.title: Tail is a slab hanging straight down
items.evidence: 1_beauty az090 tail now angles back and trails behind the hind legs, and 5_reference top shows a narrow brush; but back34 and the hind-limb close-up still show a broad, deep tail fused into the thigh.

items.title: Eyes pin-points and no mouth
items.evidence: 2_closeups head colour: large amber eye with pupil and a dark mouth line along the lip; 1_beauty az000: both eyes read at thumbnail size.

items.title: Front view cream wall with small head
items.evidence: 1_beauty az000 and 5_reference az000: still a wide cream bib block from chin down to the leg tops, the head is still small relative to the ruff width and the cheek tufts still stack beside the jaw; the bib is less long than before but not close to the reference ratio.

items.title: Belly has no tuck-up
items.evidence: 1_beauty az090: a slight rise of the cream belly behind the elbow, but the underline is still near-flat to the hind leg; 5_reference side does not show the clear waist narrowing the reference has.

regressions: Ruff clumps over the shoulder still read as same-size shards (should-fix, not improved; not a new regression)
